proof:
Source: step 4 of the parent proof (good radii, Simon (8)–(10) and 4.10), for the strip W = {a < f < b}. Dependencies: markov_point, im_concentrated, imrep_mass (C1).
1. W := {x | a < f x ∧ f x < b} = f⁻¹((a, b)) is open (isOpen_lt with f continuous, intersected).
2. By (H1) for this W, g(t) := M_W(P_t) is a.e.-measurable and ∫⁻ g ≤ L·M_W(T). By (C1) for T and RT (univ is open), M_W(T) = μ_RT(W). Put I := L·μ_RT(W). Then ∫⁻_{Ioo a b} g ≤ ∫⁻_ℝ g ≤ I (setLIntegral_le_lintegral).
3. Let p(t) be the conjunction in (H2): P_t is IM, P_t vanishes off f⁻¹{t}, and the formula holds for all ω. By (H2), p holds for a.e. t. Apply markov_point to g, p, a < b and I: there is t ∈ Ioo a b with p(t) and ENNReal.ofReal(b − a)·g(t) ≤ 2·I.
4. Fix this t. By p(t), P_t is IM, so some IMRep R_t in univ represents it, and P_t vanishes off F := f⁻¹{t}, which is closed (preimage of a point under the continuous f). Since a < t < b, F ⊆ W. By im_concentrated (X = P_t, R = R_t, F, and the open set W ⊇ F), M(P_t) ≤ M_W(P_t) = g(t).
5. Hence ENNReal.ofReal(b − a)·M(P_t) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal(b − a)·g(t) ≤ 2·(L·μ_RT(W)) (monotonicity of multiplication in [0, ∞]), and W = {x | a < f x ∧ f x < b}. Together with p(t) this gives every clause of the conclusion. ∎
Remark: in the parent text the inequality M(P_t) ≤ M_W(P_t) is obtained with a smooth Urysohn cut-off; step 4 obtains the same inequality from (C1) through im_concentrated, which only needs that P_t is IM for the chosen t.
key_steps: W = {a < f < b} is open and ∫_{(a,b)} M_W(P_t) dt ≤ L·M_W(T) = L·μ_RT(W) by (H1) and (C1).
markov_point gives t ∈ (a,b) in the a.e. set of (H2) with (b − a)·M_W(P_t) ≤ 2L·μ_RT(W).
P_t is IM and vanishes off the closed level set f⁻¹(t) ⊆ W, so im_concentrated gives M(P_t) ≤ M_W(P_t).
